name: gcc-ts-bundler
description: A TypeScript bundler that uses a native Rust front-end with Google Closure Compiler for aggressive optimization.

scripts.build: bun run build:native && bun build ./src/entry/cli.ts --outdir ./bin --format cjs --packages external --banner "#!/usr/bin/env node" --entry-naming "gcc-ts-bundler.cjs" --target node && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --format esm --packages external --entry-naming "index.mjs" --target node && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --format cjs --packages external --entry-naming "index.cjs" --target node && bun build ./src/runtime/index.ts --outdir ./dist/runtime --format esm --packages external --entry-naming "index.mjs" --target node && bun build ./src/runtime/index.ts --outdir ./dist/runtime --format cjs --packages external --entry-naming "index.cjs" --target node && bun --bun tsc -p ./tsconfig.types.json
scripts.lint: bun --bun tsc --noEmit && bun --bun ./scripts/format.ts && bun --bun eslint -c eslint.config.ts "src/**/*.ts" --fix
scripts.test: cargo test --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml && bun run build && node --test ./test/*.test.mjs
